task.description:
The requirements in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md are in an incomplete DRAFT state. Each requirement has an ID, priority, and description, but NONE have explicit acceptance criteria. Your task is to develop every requirement into a full-fledged specification by adding:

1. **Acceptance criteria** — at least one concrete, verifiable, testable statement per requirement. Use bullet form: `- GIVEN ... WHEN ... THEN ...` or `- The system SHALL return X when Y` style.
2. **Cross-references** — add `See:` references to related requirement IDs where meaningful (especially for requirements that depend on or constrain each other).
3. **Edge cases / constraints** — call out any boundary conditions implied by the description that a developer or tester could miss.

Work through each stage in order (Stage 1 → Stage 6). For each requirement:
- Keep the existing ID, priority, and description text unchanged (they are authoritative).
- Add an `**Acceptance Criteria:**` subsection directly below the description.
- Add a `**See:**` line for cross-references where applicable.

Update docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md in place.

Priority: start with all MUST requirements across all stages, then SHOULD, then COULD.

Do NOT change any requirement IDs, priorities, or description prose. Only ADD content.
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement in the document has at least one acceptance criterion
Acceptance criteria are concrete and verifiable (no vague words: reasonably, appropriately, as needed)
No new requirement IDs are introduced (only the 70 existing IDs are present)
No existing description text is altered
Cross-references use only IDs that exist in the document
fn:validate-completeness passes for all 70 requirement IDs
